title: Business Model Configurations and Performance in Physiotherapy Practices: The Moderating Role of Competitive Contracts
content: This study investigates how different business model configurations impact the performance of physiotherapy practices within a competitive healthcare environment. Specifically, it examines the influence of business model efficiency and novelty on organizational outcomes, considering the moderating effect of managed competition contracts. Using quantitative analysis of data from Dutch physiotherapy primary healthcare organizations, the research reveals nuanced relationships between business model design and performance, highlighting the importance of contractual factors in shaping these dynamics.
